title: Reasoner Outperforms: Generative Stance Detection with Rationalization for Social Media
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the stance (favor, against, or neutral) of a user's comment towards a specific topic, which included Atheism.
findings: The paper evaluated its stance detection models on a dataset that included the topic of Atheism as one of five topics. However, the results were aggregated across all topics, so no specific findings about performance on the Atheism topic alone were reported. The primary finding was that the proposed multitask learning (MTL) approach for generating both a stance and a rationale outperformed other methods, particularly in low-data settings.
